day5_intro.speaker: Officer Dave
day5_intro.text: Listen mate, we need some info on the Gumboot Gang. Hearing they're planning something big. You seen that young fella lately?

not_seen.speaker: Officer Dave
not_seen.text: No worries mate, give us a bell if you spot him, ay?

arrest_question.speaker: Officer Dave
arrest_question.text: If he's mixed up in this gang business, yeah mate. So you seen him around?

choices.text: Yeah he just took off mate

inform.speaker: Officer Dave
inform.text: Choice mate, good on ya. We'll track him down.

day6_intro.speaker: Officer Dave
day6_intro.text: Cheers for your help yesterday mate, we got some good intel off that.

choices.text: What happened to the kid, mate?

kid_fate.speaker: Officer Dave
kid_fate.text: Had to arrest the young fella, mate. He was helping the Gumboot boys. They were gonna ram raid your dairy tonight. Luckily we got most of them, but the boss is still out there.

kid_fate.speaker: Officer Dave
kid_fate.text: Yeah anyways, thanks for the help mate! I'll just be getting this

day7_check_ending.speaker: Officer Dave
day7_check_ending.text: Right mate, final day. We've been watching your shop all week...

ending_branch.speaker: Officer Dave
ending_branch.text: You did good, mate. Thanks to you, we shut down the Gumboot Gang. You kept your nose clean.

clean_ending.speaker: Officer Dave
clean_ending.text: Thanks for your help with the investigation. Stay safe out there, mate.
